name: graphify
description: Standalone graphify knowledge-graph runner. Points graphify at any corpus — a directory of code, a Supabase database schema, or an arbitrary file set — and produces a full LLM-named-community knowledge graph (god nodes, communities, import cycles, isolated nodes) without running a whole repo analysis. Carries the canonical MoxyWolf runner protocol (team OpenRouter key via DR-010, two-pass AST-then-label split that survives the Cowork sandbox, keyless fallback) as the single source of truth; github-repo-analyzer delegates its Step 0 here. Built for MoxyWolf LLC internal use.
